title: BSI v1 - Block Structural Interface (machine-readable contract)
description: Headers are JSON validated by the definitions below; payload sections are binary records described under x-records. Field order in headers is the order listed. Units are SI. Any key starting with x- is a vendor extension and is ignored-with-count by engines that do not understand it; any other unknown key is PROTOCOL_ERROR.

id128.x-note: Nonzero; high word then low word, each 16 lowercase hex digits.

responseBase.x-note: payloadBytes/payloadB64 appear only on the stdio-b64 transport (Part G 2026-09-02 item 3); the conformance runner strips them before C-1/C-2 comparison.

x-rules: role in {member,panel,monolith} requires E,rho and (nu or G)
role=support requires supportKind; mechanical fields ignored
allow.sigmaC,sigmaT,tau all > 0 => asymmetric fibre screen; else allow.sigma required
model starting with x- requires capability bsi.material.x-<vendor>, otherwise UNSUPPORTED

x-kinds.custom: explicit A,Iy,Iz,J,cy,cz,Asy,Asz,Zy,Zz,principalAngle; Zy/Zz are PLASTIC section moduli (Part G 2026-09-02 item 7)

reinstallRetired.description: Reuse complete matching retired material history through the same topology transaction. Requires retainLoadPath and transferTopology.

x-arena.reply: one T-A frame (12-byte prefix + header + payload); sections[].offset relative to payload start; doorbell replyLen = frame bytes
x-arena.x-identified-payload: declare: blocks in world, owners in attrs; edit: complete edits+owners in world; fracture verbs: empty payload
x-arena.x-retry: After needBigger, resend identical header and payload; seq may change. A different request is refused while the original reply is pending. The original operation is never dispatched twice.
x-arena.x-arc-payload: corotArcAdvance: empty; load catalog retained from initialAnalysis
x-arena.x-checkpoint-payload: corotCheckpointExport: empty; corotCheckpointImport: complete opaque checkpoint in loads

x-capi.frame: 'F' 'C' | flags u16 | headerLen u32 | payloadLen u32 | header | payload (LE); one call = one frame in, one frame out
x-capi.retry: NEED_BIGGER caches one executed request/reply; byte-identical retry only copies the reply; different pending request returns PROTOCOL

x-canonicalOrder.blocks: lexicographic (x, y, z) ascending on int32; duplicates refused
x-canonicalOrder.loads: lexicographic (x, y, z) ascending, ties broken by memcmp of the raw 64-byte record
x-canonicalOrder.members|facets|stations: id ascending; stations by s ascending within a member
x-canonicalOrder.unassigned: by why enum order, then block order
x-canonicalOrder.warnings: diag.warnings by code ascending (bytewise), counts merged
